Founding member of multimedia design studio [Lamosca sccl](https://www.lamosca.com).

During my years at Lamosca I First directed our multimedia section and then internet section. I worked mainly in web development and multimedia applications in various formats, and in organizational and team coordination tasks.

In recent years, I have combined this main line of work with teaching at several universities.

I also built and participated in projects (and debates) for many clients, of all sizes and in almost all possible formats.

The above has allowed me to maintain a permanent state of training and learning around IT, particularly in Frontend development.
